name: @telenow/shopify-app
description: Telenow Voice AI for Shopify: an AI voice agent that automatically calls shoppers for abandoned cart recovery, cash-on-delivery (COD) confirmation and RTO reduction, order confirmation, delivery and shipping updates, failed-delivery (NDR) retry, win-back, instant lead callback, and review/NPS calls — and writes the call outcome back onto the order. Free app; requires a Telenow account billed on usage.

scripts.dev:preview: npm run dev:seed && SHOPIFY_API_KEY=dev SHOPIFY_API_SECRET=dev HOST=http://localhost:3000 PORT=3000 node src/server.js
